name: Whip Spark
description: Snap the wrist and let a thin spark trail after the hand like the tip of a whip.

name: Arc Wrap
description: Wrap a band of crackling charge round a target's wrist and pull the arm to one side.

name: Flick Guard
description: Flick the lash across an incoming strike to knock it off line with a snap of charge.

name: Lash Read
description: Let the loose end of the lash drift in the air to feel the nearby bodies by the tug of charge.

name: Fork Sweep
description: Sweep the arm in a flat arc and let a forked lash sting everyone within its reach.

name: Tip Sting
description: Drive the narrow tip of the lash into one point of a target's cloth and skin.

name: Cross Lash
description: Lash twice in a cross so the crossed bite stuns the muscle struck and spoils the target's next move.

name: Lash Lock
description: Hold a target's limb wrapped in the lash for several beats while the other hand is free to strike.

name: Charge Stride
description: Load the thighs with charge and cover three paces in a single leaping stride.

name: Spark Glide
description: Skim over level ground on a thin trail of sparks from the soles for several paces.

name: Landing Snap
description: Land from a leaping stride with a charged elbow already driving into the target.

name: Turn Spark
description: Spin out of a straight attack and throw a spark at the striker's wrist to turn it aside.

name: Step Scan
description: Land lightly and read from the feet where charge is drawn so that hidden bodies show.

name: Chain Stride
description: Link several strides on a running trail of charge so that the user crosses a wide gap in an unbroken run.

name: Stride Bolt
description: Throw a bolt from the front foot at the end of a stride, aimed past a target's guard.

name: Volt Shell
description: Wrap the body in a close shell of humming charge that dulls blows and cuts.

name: Spark Return
description: Turn a small hostile spark back along its line to bite the thrower on the hand.

name: Charged Screen
description: Raise a flat screen of charge before the open palm to stop a thrown pebble or dart.

name: Guard Crackle
description: Let the shell crackle outward when touched so the hand that touched it jerks back.

name: Volt Turn
description: Roll the forearm along a blade's flat, charge snapping, until the edge slides off.

name: Shield Probe
description: Feel the shell's skin for the push of an unseen blow and learn the direction it comes from.

name: Hardened Shell
description: Pack the shell dense and tight over the whole body to take a heavy blow without cracking.

name: Barbed Shell
description: Let the shell throw back a stinging shock into any fist or weapon that strikes it.

name: Shell Pulse
description: Burst the shell outward in one ring of charge that knocks back every foe pressing in close.

name: Low Rumble
description: Hum a deep rumble of charge into the air so that nearby heads swim and footing slips.

name: Peal Strike
description: Strike the ground with a fist and send a short peal of pressure over those close by.

name: Thunder Skip
description: Stamp forward on a rumble that carries the user a pace ahead of a rival.

name: Drum Hand
description: Beat a charged open hand on a target's chest like a drum, shaking the breath in it.

name: Long Roll
description: Roll a continuous peal from the palms over a wide front, wearing down the footing of all in it.

name: Roll Crash
description: Slam both fists in together on a peal so the crash drives into the target's guard and ribs.

name: Nerve Tap
description: Tap a bundle of nerves on a target's arm so a small pulse of charge makes it twitch.

name: Slack Jolt
description: Rest a charged touch on a limb until the feeling in it fades and it hangs slack.

name: Elbow Jolt
description: Drive a pulse into the elbow joint so the forearm flies open and the grip fails.

name: Wrist Jolt
description: Jolt the wrist of a target holding a weapon so the fingers spring open.

name: Twitch Spark
description: Flick a small spark at a nerve near the surface and set a leg or cheek twitching.

name: Grip Seize
description: Clamp a target's hand open or shut with a steady pulse so it cannot work.

name: Jolt Read
description: Let a faint pulse run through a body and read the strained nerves to find a weak or hurt limb.

name: Spine Shock
description: Touch the base of a target's spine with a hard pulse so the legs buckle and the body loses poise.

name: Cramp Arc
description: Send an arc along a target's muscles until they cramp, slowing every move for several beats.

name: Clear Pulse
description: Send a measured pulse through an ally's limb to jolt out a numbing venom or a lingering cramp.

name: Steady Current
description: Hold a steady current in the arms between strikes so the next one lands with charge.

name: Trickle Feed
description: Feed charge into a tired limb in a slow trickle to keep it from failing.

name: Tight Coil
description: Coil charge round the torso in tight loops that turn a glancing blow aside.

name: Coil Release
description: Let the held coil spring free through the fist as it meets the target.

name: Current Gauge
description: Check how much charge is banked in the body and how much a rival holds by touch.

name: Banked Spark
description: Loose a spark kept ready in the fingertip without gathering, in the time of one breath.

name: Charged Fist
description: Wrap the whole fist in banked charge so that the punch bursts into the target on contact.

name: Held Burst
description: Loose the whole bank at once in an even burst that jolts every body within a short span.

name: Earth Run
description: Run with each footfall leaning on the ground's current to gain a pace on every stride.

name: Soil Spark
description: Drive a spark into the ground so it races beneath the surface and bursts at a target's feet.

name: Vein Seek
description: Follow a line of charge through the ground to find a vein of metal or water below.

name: Stone Jolt
description: Touch a stone and thrust its stored charge into the target who stands upon or leans on it.

name: Stance Hum
description: Spread charge under both soles so a shaking floor or loose stone cannot topple the user.

name: Low Lash
description: Send a lash of charge along the ground in a line that stings every foot it touches.

name: Sunk Anchor
description: Sink the whole body's charge deep through the legs so that it cannot be thrown, shoved or lifted.

name: Link Spark
description: Throw a spark that leaves a faint link behind it for the next spark to follow.

name: Chain Touch
description: Touch one body with a charged hand and let the charge pass on to the next body it touches.

name: Link Read
description: Send a link out to several bodies in turn and read their numbers and positions.

name: Link Shell
description: Wear a loose chain of charge about the arms that catches and spreads a blow.

name: Link Step
description: Step along a link of charge toward a marked target, closing the gap in a flicker.

name: Short Chain
description: Loop a short chain of charge about a target's ankles to hobble the next step.

name: Chain Arc
description: Throw an arc that jumps from the first target to a second and a third standing close.

name: Chain Break
description: Snap a hard pulse down a foe's own channeled charge so that their hold on it breaks.

name: Long Link
description: Hold a single thread of charge on a target at long range and drive it deep through their guard.
